briefings.title: Hester Peirce Explains What Crypto Still Needs Before She Leaves the SEC

people.name: Scott Melker
people.role: Host, The Wolf Of All Streets

briefings.tldr: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce outlines how the agency is using existing authority to advance crypto regulation through a new five-year tokenized stock innovation exemption following the Clarity Act's failure.

briefings.title: Hester Peirce: The Positive Future of Digital Asset Regulation (Huge Catalysts Coming)
briefings.tldr: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce highlights the agency's efforts to modernize market structures through the proposed removal of the 20-year-old Rule 611 and the upcoming "innovation exemption," emphasizing that future regulations must pragmatically support on-chain finance while fiercely protecting investor privacy, self-custody, and developer freedom.

briefings.title: Hester Peirce: The Positive Future of Digital Asset Regulation (Huge Catalysts Coming)
briefings.tldr: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce highlights a pivotal shift toward digital asset integration, emphasizing the SEC’s proposed elimination of the 20-year-old Rule 611 and the development of an "innovation exemption" to facilitate controlled, on-chain financial experimentation.

briefings.title: SEC’s Hester Peirce: ‘We Lost Time’ on Crypto
briefings.tldr: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce acknowledges that the U.S. "lost time" on crypto regulation due to an enforcement-first approach under previous leadership, but she expresses optimism that a new DC consensus—driven by both legislative efforts like the Clarity Act and SEC-led guidance—is finally providing the industry with the necessary regulatory framework.

briefings.title: SEC Chair Paul Atkins and SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce in Conversation
briefings.tldr: The SEC is pivoting from "regulation by enforcement" to a collaborative, guidance-based framework, spearheaded by "Project Crypto"—a joint initiative with the CFTC—and a proposed "Innovation Exemption" to facilitate regulated experimentation in tokenized securities and DeFi.
